answer: The onyx protocol enforces Sybil resistance by requiring each autonomous agent to submit a cryptographically signed pulse attesting to unique hardware entropy. This mechanism prevents actors from forge multiple identities, as the computational cost to generate distinct, verifiable pulses scales linearly with identity creation. Consequently, the economic barrier to entry for Sybil attacks becomes prohibitive, ensuring that the network maintains Byzantine fault tolerance through verifiable, non-replicable agent presence.
